_comment: Seal source of truth (Day 10). README results table and the resume MUST render from this file; regenerate everything with the commands in each entry. Tree: ros2_tunnel_explorer bline-merge-20260908; D-line linear_mpc_controller cloud-exploration-20260908.
_gauge: All grid numbers gauge odom against masks generated by plan_from_map over the map the sim actually served (cleaning_room_rect.yaml, origin -3.0/-2.0; verified via map_server logs). Earlier map_saved-mask grid numbers (0.2486/0.2836 historical and first-pass Day 6-8) were a frame mismatch and are RETRACTED.

coverage_chain.segments: 36-37/37 covered per run, 0-1 failed (run6: one WORK_TRACKING_FAILED)
coverage_chain.served_map: cleaning_room_rect (static), origin -3.0/-2.0; executable cells 6996; python-canonical route 60.75 m / 22 waypoints
reproduce: python3 <tunnel>/scripts/regen_plan_from_masks.py --masks <audit_masks.npz> --outdir <dir>  (python plan reproducibility over a given map)
python3 <D-line>/benchmark_tools/scripts/plan_from_map.py --map-yaml <served map yaml> --outdir <dir>  (gauge masks over the served map)
coverage_chain.claim: segment ledger stable (+/-1.5%, executor-internal); grid coverage_task 0.221-0.261 (mean 0.238) is map-area coverage of the driven path against the served-map executable mask -- NOT a plan-trace match to the python route; report RANGE + both denominators; executor ledger != absolute coverage.

mpc_matrix.claim: 3 geometry x 2 v_min x 2 projection modes; failure axis = geometry & v_min, not projection implementation (10/12 cells identical across modes); cap geometry passes at both v_min -> no maneuver-generation layer needed; nocap needs negative velocity; backward needs true reversing.
mpc_matrix.real_path_audit: 16/250 plan reference points exceed omega_max=2.0 on the raw plan; fix rule v <= omega_max/|kappa| implemented (D-line 85276e3).

b6b_nav2_plugin.claims: sandbox gates stage1 4/4, 2a 7/7, 2b 8/8; terminal-clamp negative control intact 1.98 m vs clamp-disabled 13.14-13.16 m (delta 11.18 m); NOT wired into the coverage chain; NO hard-real-time claim.

boundaries: No hard real-time statement is authorized.

Executor plans internally via C++ ScanlinePlanner over the served static map; python cleaning_mode is canonical only for plan reproducibility over the served map (60.75 m / 22 waypoints on cleaning_room_rect) and is NOT route-identical to the executor's segments.
Chain controller = RotationShim + DWB; the linear-MPC plugin is a separate sandbox-verified deliverable.
map_saved-gauge coverage numbers (historical 0.2486/0.2836) are retracted as coverage claims.
U9-era entrance-hysteresis A/B numbers (1/5, 590 s, -45% goals) are NOT reproducible from any committed tree and are excluded from README and resume.
